title: 10.1.1 | Bugfix Patch
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/a41307f166110da0c26300b89684e9a71f8ef6ae.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Killer Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]The Judgment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the Divine Light curve window while Zealous to 0.6s [i](was 0.3s)
Dev note: The decoupling of the curve window from the delay phase was good, but the duration of the window was much too short. As a result, we are doubling it to give players a longer window to curve Divine Light while Zealous. We will continue to monitor this value.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Knight[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dropping a Pallet while being Hunted by a Guard now causes the Guard to path around the Pallet[/p][list][*][p]If the resulting Guard Path is greater than [b]48m [/b]the Guard will abandon the Hunt[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Dropping a Pallet on a Guard now causes the Guard to move through the Pallet[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Perk Updates[/b][/h3][h3][b]Survivor perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Repressed Alliance:
[/b]After repairing Generators for [b]40/35/30s[/b], while repairing a Generator alone, use[b] [/b]the Active Ability button to block that generator for [b]15s[/b]. [i](was 55/50/45 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Vigil
[/b]All Survivors within [b]16m[/b] of you:
Lose Exhausted [b]20/25/30%[/b] faster. [i](was 30/35/40%)
[/i]After they leave your range, this ends after [b]15s[/b].
[i]Dev note: We have heard concerns that the lower value may be too low. We will be monitoring this change carefully to see if further adjustments are required.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment voice line about Aurora plays in the store.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the sound effect that indicates the Divine Light will hit and injures Survivor continues to play when The Judgment cancels the Power.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some audio SFX throughout the application are muffled or missing when leaving any Tutorials.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the SFX and Haptic Feedback from the Torment Trail are missing after falling during the action.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where missing SFX when the Pig knife extend after standing up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there is an inaccurate SFX audible range when The Xenomorph misses the Tail Attack or when the tail is obstructed by environment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when using the MiNa Legendary outfit as Trickster, some Default Trickster voice lines could play after exiting "Main Event"[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Characters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment's cooldown after cancelling or timing out Divine Light was shorter than intended[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's body, while in Head Form, remains floating briefly during the falling animation when using a Vault that leads to a fall.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Aurora's book floats when holding an item during the idle animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph's inner mouth does not open during the Mori when using most cosmetics.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the hair braid for Survivor Thalita Lyra's lacks physics when performing any action in a match.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where swapping the head cosmetic on the 'Splinter Rose' full body outfit on The Knight causes the killer's back to stretch forward unnaturally during the lobby animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the auras of The Lich's flying entities appear even if the opaque original mesh is not obstructed by other geometry[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Onryo could be seen more than 24 meters away while demanifested.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where yellow blood VFX was displayed when Liberating a Survivor from the Exile when playing against The Judgment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment's Crown of The Destroyer add-on failed to trigger the Terror Radius condition for multiple perks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Pallet debris VFX could appear sooner than expected when The Slasher was breaking Pallets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's Head Form remained floating briefly in the falling animation when using a Vault that led to a fall.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment could become unable to use its power after sending a Survivor to the Exile and charging the power right after.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant could not Deploy a Drone when standing on a floor above/below a Hooked Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Legion's Arms are stretched in the Gameplay Showcase.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Autohave Wreckers Realm where the Nurse could blink inside the Hill[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Yamaoka Estate Realm where projectiles would be blocked around the Shrine Landmark tile[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Shelter Woods where a tree would clip through the interior of the Apartment container[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Midwich Elementary School where the Blight could not bounce of a couch when using his power[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Pale Rose where the camera of the Survivor would clip through the roof of the boat[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Dead Dawg Saloon where the Nurse could blink on top of the railing of the Gallow and navigate on top of invisible collisions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Midwich Elementary School where the Nurse could not blink through the caged restroom stalls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Blood Lodge where the debris of a broken pallet did not appear on the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Midwich Elementary School where the Killers could not grab a survivor that was on the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Temple of Purgation where the Killer would be able to hit a survivor through a wall[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Badham Preschool where the Mastermind could not dash on a driveway curb[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Coldwind Farm where the Nurse is able to blink inside a hay stack[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Dead Dawg Saloon where a crawling survivor gets stuck at the top of the stairs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Badham Preschool where a bush is blocking the navigation of players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where on The Thompson House, a Shrine could appear 20 meters away from the closest Generator when starting a Custom Trial with less than 4 Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, on Nostromo Wreckage, the Keycard's Aura remained visible after hacking the terminal.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Perks[/b][/p][list][*][p]TEXT ONLY: Fixed the description of No One Left Behind to say: "You heal [b]other Survivors[/b]... faster" and not: "You heal faster".[/p][/*][*][p]TEXT ONLY: Fixed the description of Deathbound to specify which effects affect which Survivor, and that it only applies to a single Survivor at a time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue to ensure Mettle of Man procured, only after the third protection hit.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Still Sight could not be activated after a Survivor was rescued from the Exile.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed several incorrect statements in the Gameplay Showcase[/p][/*][*][p]Play button sound fix[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some visual problems with the new matchmaking button not appearing everywhere it should. (and appearing where it shouldn't)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, as The Judgment, the charging bar remained displayed when Divine Light was cancelled before the end of the charge.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment's Zealous Icon appeared disabled when Divine Light was on Cooldown.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment's mini-Mori indicator appeared when a Heretic Survivor in their second hook stage was hooked.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment's Divine Light aiming reticule stayed visible after the control period expired while Zealous.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Misc[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where blessing a Hex totem did not trigger a score event.[/p][/*][/list]
